description: We are a group of five university students majoring in Computer Science who are passionate about solving real-world problems through technology and creativity. We enjoy exploring challenges, developing innovative ideas, and turning problems into meaningful solutions.
summary: Our project is an educational visual storytelling presentation titled "Forgotten Space Heroes" created using Canva to introduce children aged 8 to 12 and space enthusiasts to the forgotten hardware left on the Moon, and Mars. Through colourful illustrations, engaging facts, and easy-to-understand storytelling, our goal is to make space science more interesting, accessible, and inspiring by turning complex histories into an engaging visual journey that encourages curiosity about the universe.
details:
Our project, "Forgotten Space Heroes," is an engaging educational video presentation designed to introduce students and space enthusiasts to historic lunar and Martian missions. The video highlights iconic space explorers like the Apollo Lunar Module, Surveyor 3, Sojourner, and InSight, showcasing how past missions paved the way for modern space exploration.

We created this video to make space science more accessible and exciting through storytelling and an interactive trivia quiz segment. Viewers can follow along as the video explores lunar soil, Marsquakes, and ancient Martian water history in a fun, gamified way.

For development, our team used Canva to design the visual assets, slides, and layouts, and integrated them into a cohesive video format to ensure smooth pacing and clear storytelling.

As a team, we focused on viewer engagement, visual clarity, and educational value, ensuring that the historical facts are both accurate and easy for younger audiences to understand. The project is creative because it transforms complex aerospace history into inspiring "heroes" through dynamic video storytelling, motivating the next generation of space explorers.
